name: Darkpool David
bio: Darkpool David is the pseudonymous lead writer behind the Incognito Browser resource library. He covers consumer browser privacy, tracking-mitigation techniques, and the practical day-to-day of staying anonymous online — from fingerprinting defenses to threat-model-appropriate VPN, DNS, and encryption choices. He writes pseudonymously by design: privacy reporting is harder when the writer's own identity becomes part of the story.
credentials: Writes pseudonymously. 10+ years following the consumer browser-privacy and surveillance-economy beat. Editorial voice behind the incognitobrowser.io resource library and supporting publications.
